[SWS_DM_01395] SOVD method Start Execution of an Operation proximity_response
⌈
The proximity_reponse in the request body of SOVD
method Start Execution of an Operation shall be validated using ara::-
diag::SovdProximityChallenge::GetChallenge.
⌋

The proximity_reponse in the request body of SOVD method Start Execution
of an Operation shall be validated using ara::diag::SovdProximityChal-
lenge::GetChallenge.
⌋

[SWS_DM_01395] Validation of SOVD operation proximity_response
⌈
If a SOVD request body contains a proximity_response, the Diagnostic
Server instance shall call the method ara::diag::SovdProximityChal-
lenge::ValidateResponse with the parameter proximityResponse set to the con-
tent from the request body and consider the proximity_challenge valid, if kProx-
imityChallengeValidationSuccessful is returned.
⌋
